# Fleet standard — project copy

Copied from the fleet standard v3.8.0 by `sync-standards`, together with the
skills in `.claude/skills/`, so they load in cloud sessions, which install no plugins.
`scripts/block-shell-writes.mjs` is the §AGENTS shell-write hook, registered in
`.claude/settings.json`.

**Do not edit these files.** The next sync overwrites them. A fix goes back to
`Tanveerfb/fleet-standards` through `propose-standard`.

This folder is what the last sync copied, **not the master**: never compare the project's
rules against `.claude/fleet/project-rules.md` to decide whether it is current.
